run_wordlist_explorer: run the explorer function to launch CLIP model training jobs on word list datasets via SLURM
configure_slurm_grid: configure SLURM grid parameters with 2 GPUs and 200 MB per GPU for word list evaluations
bind_clip_conv_model: bind the clip_conv model with batch size 128 for training on audio word list selections
setup_job_array_seeds: setup a job array loop over seeds 2036, 2037, 2038 for reproducible word list training runs
set_dataset_timebounds: set dataset time bounds tmin and tmax for shorter context window word list evaluations
